section_1__text_3: These Terms apply to all visitors, users, and anyone who accesses or uses the Website.
section_2__text: Oakdene House Foundation (ABN: 90 151 950 926) is a registered Australian charity based in Fairfield, Western Sydney.
section_2__text_2: We support individuals and families affected by addiction, hardship, homelessness, and other life challenges through counselling, community programs, practical assistance, referral pathways, and related support services.
section_2__text_3: Our Website is operated for community information and support access purposes. It is not a commercial platform and does not operate for profit.
section_3__text: You may access and use the Website for personal, non-commercial purposes only, including to:

section_3__text_2: You must not use the Website to:

Our Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, and protect your personal information in accordance with the Privacy Act 1988 (Cth), the Australian Privacy Principles (APPs), and the Health Records and Information Privacy Act 2002 (NSW) (HRIP Act).

section_10__heading: 10. Privacy and Serious Invasions of Privacy
section_10__text: In addition to our obligations under the Privacy Act and these Terms, please note that from 10 June 2025, Australian law recognises a tort of serious invasion of privacy. This means individuals may have a cause of action where personal information about them has been collected, used, or disclosed in a way that seriously and intentionally or recklessly invades their privacy, and where their reasonable expectation of privacy was not respected.
section_10__text_2: Oakdene House Foundation is committed to handling all personal information, including information submitted through this Website, in a manner that respects privacy and complies with all applicable laws. If you have concerns about how your personal information has been handled, please contact our Privacy Officer in the first instance.
section_11__text: We aim to make our Website available at all times, but we do not guarantee that the Website will be continuously available or free from errors. We may suspend, withdraw, or restrict access to some or all of the Website at any time without notice for operational, maintenance, or security reasons.
section_12__text: Our Website is intended for use by adults and by service providers, carers, or family members seeking information on behalf of others. Our Website is not directed at children under the age of 18.
section_12__text_2: If you are accessing our services on behalf of a child or a person who may be vulnerable, please contact us directly so that we can ensure that appropriate safeguards and support processes are in place. We apply additional care when collecting information about or on behalf of children, young people, or persons with compromised capacity to consent, and we may require involvement of a parent, guardian, or responsible person.
